items.question: What arises when hidden true nature is known?
items.inference: Knowing hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: Compound parsing of gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ is not fully certain.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
